purpose: Define the canonical communication lane for planner, coder, verifier, consultant, and human discussion without inflating the task control packet.

authoritative_lane.control_packet_rule: The task packet stores refs and status only; discussion bodies live in task_communication.

channel_vocabulary.purpose: Actionable requests that can block or redirect execution.

discuss_current.purpose: Project Discuss workspace role labels over the canonical lane.

assist_loop.purpose: Runner-emitted guidance and recovery coordination metadata.

threading_rules.continuation_rule: Related planning/recovery continuations must reuse or explicitly reply_to the originating thread when preserving lineage.

large_payload_rule.inline_payload: Keep message bodies concise and summary-first.
large_payload_rule.overflow_strategy: Use refs for plans, evidence bundles, transcripts, or large generated content.
